why: Figure 2 is the mirror image of figure 1: the corner lines go from the bottom-left quarter to the bottom-right quarter. Mirroring figure 3 (top-left) gives the top-right quarter with the corner exactly at the centre: option 4. Option 3 looks similar, but its corner is not at the centre of the circle.
trick: For mirror-type pairs, also check small details such as where the corner point sits.
